title: cassia aurata
intro: Cassia aurata, commonly known as the gold leaf cassia or golden cassia, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is prized for its rich health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cassia aurata include soothing skin irritations, reducing pain, and treating gastrointestinal issues. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
